title: UFOs shut down nuclear missiles

tellings.quote: I've I've interviewed a lot of those guys firsthand and I think they're all legit.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaks about the story that UFOs have shut down nuclear missiles at US missile sites. He says he has interviewed many of the men involved firsthand and thinks they are all legitimate, which, if they are right, would mean something unknown can switch off the country's nuclear weapons.
